title: Bamboo farm
description: This small mod adds a new block that will automatically grow bamboo.
body:
![Using of farms](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc705a0c044d9014dbb033540dc5fd1537d7eab0.png)

A small mod that adds a block that automatically grows bamboo.

Block crafting is close to the construction of a real bamboo farm.
